bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; establishing that exposure of a human breast alone is not indecent exposure; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 617.23, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 617.23, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 5.

Exposure of human breast.

Exposure of a human breast alone does not constitute lewd exposure, gross lewdness, or lascivious behavior.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective July 1, 2026.
